name: ghostex-branch-graph
title: Branch Graph
description: A compact Git commit graph with remote status, background fetch and explicit pull/push actions, following your active project and worktree.
author: knutpfr

preferences.name: autoRefresh
preferences.title: Automatic refresh
preferences.description: Refresh every five seconds while the graph is visible.

preferences.name: autoFetch
preferences.title: Fetch remotes every minute
preferences.description: Check for remote commits while the graph is visible. Never pulls or pushes automatically.

preferences.name: transparent
preferences.title: Transparency and app tint
preferences.description: Follow Ghostex's theme and app tint. Native transparency depends on the host; see README.md.
